messages.subject: dotchart sorting/ordering
parts:
I like the old Cleveland dotchrat layouts from the 1;980s. I am
trying to do a couple of very simple dotcharts with no sulccess.

Problem one
I have a factor going from a:j. It loads from a at the bottom to j at
the top. How do I reverse this?
I suspect that I need to change factor levels but I'm not sure how to
approach it.

Alternatively how to I order/sort the numeric values so that I have
them from highest at top to lowest at bottom?

Simple-minded examples hat are not working.
Thanks
======================================
library(ggplot2)
set.seed(100)
df1 <- data.frame(aa=as.factor(letters[1:10]),
bb=rnorm(10))
qplot(bb, aa, data=df1)


(df2 <- df1[order( df1[,1],decreasing=TRUE),])
qplot(bb, aa, data=df2)

messages.author: 0c39e60ddb38622b
messages.subject: Re: dotchart sorting/ordering
parts:
Hi:

# (1)
df1$aaa <- factor(df1$aa, levels = letters[10:1])
qplot(bb, aaa, data=df1)

# (2)
qplot(bb, reorder(aa, bb), data = df1)

reorder() is used to reorder the levels of a factor according to some
criterion, in this case the values of bb.

HTH,
Dennis
